segments: ... and they began and plundered the region of Hizan Mansur and of Gargar and Ga'khti;
and they killed everyone who did not confess with his tongue:
"Papa (or Baba) is the divine Apostle and the Prophet."
Now the governor of Melitene gathered his force, five hundred horsemen,
and he took for his help also from the dependents of the Monastery of Mar Bar Sauma fifty chosen foot-soldiers, archers.
And they went and engaged the Turcomans,
and those of the territory of the Romans were defeated,
and none of the dependents escaped from them except a few.
And then those Turcomans were exceedingly emboldened,
and many multitudes joined them.
And they went into {OCR?} the district of Albistan,
and they also defeated the army that was there.
And they set their face to go to Amasya,
and to meet him whom they were proclaiming.
Now the magnates of the Romans laid an ambush for that old man Papa (or Baba),
and they seized him and strangled him.
And when Isaac his disciple went with his partisans and they did not find him,
they reported: "He has ascended to heaven to bring angels to their help."
And they launched a fierce attack upon Amasya.
And there gathered from the territory of the Romans about sixty thousand horsemen,
and they were not able to overcome that small camp of six thousand of those deluded ones.
Then a thousand Frankish horsemen who were in the service of the Sultan grew zealous and gnashed their teeth,
and they marked the sign of the Cross upon their faces,
and they attacked those deluded ones and routed them.
Then the Arabs/Muslims also joined them and surrounded those Turcomans like a circle,
and they destroyed them all with the edge of the sword,
and they left alive of them neither man, nor woman, nor child, nor any beast at all in which was breath.
And thus was this heresy extinguished.
And in this same year the armies of the territory of the Romans assembled,
and Sinan Subashi of Hisn Ziyad was placed {OCR?} at their head,
who had been appointed in the place of Bayramish who had been killed;
and they went and encamped against Amid.
And its master was
the son of al-Kamil who was in Egypt.
And those of the territory of the Romans made an agreement with the guards,
and promised them money,
and they surrendered the city.
And the Aleppines also were going as help along with those of the territory of the Romans.
